About

Meet the artist behind the glow

Hi, I'm [Artist name]. I started Joluck Makeup Empire because I believe makeup should feel like you, only more sure of yourself.

Every appointment begins with your skin, not a template. We talk, we prep, and then we build a look that suits your face, your outfit, and the kind of day you are about to have.

If you want to learn, my classes teach the same way I work: slowly, clearly, and with respect for every skin tone.

  • Skin firstPrep and shade matching come before a single colour goes on.
  • Long-lasting finishTechniques and products chosen to hold through heat, dancing and photos.
  • Client comfortA calm chair, honest advice and a look you feel good wearing.

How it works

From first message to glow

  1. 1

    Chat

    Message us on WhatsApp with your date, your outfit and the look you have in mind.

  2. 2

    Book

    Confirm your slot with a deposit. We note your skin type, your colours and any allergies.

  3. 3

    Glow

    Arrive, settle in and relax while we prep your skin and build your look.

  4. 4

    Celebrate

    Walk out ready for your day, with touch-up tips to keep the finish all evening.
